notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.2
notes.content:
Fixed a handful of things to make the play experience smoother, including:
[list]
[*] Drawing sequences should work a bit better now
[*] Water droplets sequence easier to complete (ch 2)
[*] Metronome is a bit more forgiving (ch 3)
[*] Clockhand animates faster now (ch 5)
[*] Plating interaction tweaks (ch 6)
[*] Fixed collision issue in Foraging (ch 6)
[/list]

...plus a bunch of other small stuff. Also fixed a couple translation issues. 

Happy Hindsighting!
-Joel
